newsitem.title: USA: HL&P to shut South Texas 1 nuclear unit.
newsitem.headline: HL&P to shut South Texas 1 nuclear unit.

text.p: Houston Lighting & Power Co plans to shut for maintenance its 1,250 megawatt (MW) South Texas 1 nuclear power plant for the weekend, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) said Thursday.
The maintenance work involves a test that was postponed from last weekend due to cold weather and high power demand in the region, an NRC spokesman said.
The unit, in Palacios, Tx., is expected to off line just for the weekend, he said.
The company was not immediately available to confirm or comment on the planned outage.
Houston Lighting & Power is a subsidiary of Houston Industries Inc.
